csv_project_name: AE for Union Pacific Railroad Window Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The UPRR Window extends from immediately upstream of the existing I-Street Bridge to downstream of the bridge from approximate Station 55+44 to 57+08 and further detailed in Figure X. The proposed work will close a gap in the existing levee and present recommended flood control features in this area. This project aims to address deficiencies of the area at the intersection of the levee crown and railroad to mitigate geometric levee height and slope deficiencies, as well as seepage, stability, overtopping, and erosion issues, to reduce the risk of flooding from high-water events on the Sacramento River. The selected mitigation strategy must avoid impacts on railroad operations to the extent practical. The IStreet Bridge railroad lines primarily support Union Pacific Railroad (UPRR) freight and Amtrak commuter and long-distance passenger rail services.
